[[File:Francis K. Lalumiere DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Francis Lalumiere at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Francis Lalumiere''' was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] (Gold 28, earlier Red 23) who wrote SWCCG articles for Decipher's website and ''Scrye''.<ref name="decsq-prof" /><ref name="sm-fan" /> He also wrote Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] Design Diary.<ref name="jkpersonae" />

He joined the squadron in 1996 in Montreal and traveled to Tunisia as part of the 1996 World Championships grand prize. He wrote articles for Decipher's website and ''Scrye'', and from fall 1998 wrote for Lucasfilm's website.<ref name="decsq-prof" /> His first articles on decipher.com appeared in 1997.<ref name="swyear">[http://www.decipher.com/newsflash/1999/1299/122999storyA.html The Star Wars Year – Francis Lalumiere], Decipher NewsFlash, decipher.com (29 December 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000229064738/http://www.decipher.com:80/newsflash/1999/1299/122999storyA.html Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher welcomed him to its web team in late 1999,<ref name="thu19" /><ref name="swyear" /> and he signed his NewsFlash stories with his Decipher title, The Juggler.<ref name="nf081700" /> His last bylined pieces on decipher.com appeared in April 2001.<ref name="dd042501" /><ref name="12d11" /> Decipher's Radio Free Decipher broadcast of 8 June 2001, "The Prodigal Son Returns", billed him as a guest host visiting "from the great white north".<ref name="rfd2001">[http://www.decipher.com/rfd/archives/index2001.html Radio Free Decipher archives, 2001] (Broadcast 84, 8 June 2001), decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020811064036/http://www.decipher.com:80/rfd/archives/index2001.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Lalumiere wrote Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] Design Diary (October 2000 – April 2001) and is credited on the game's team.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref>
